Dual filters, envelopes/LFOs/functions and performance macros

recipes.name: Moving acid phrase
steps: Start with a single analog-style source and a resonant low-pass filter.
Use a short amplitude gate and a fast-decaying filter envelope; vary cutoff and accents across the phrase.
Keep fundamental sub separately centered; print a short note test before a full phrase.

recipes.name: Chopped emotional keys
steps: Build a voiced minor/add9 phrase from a restrained analog or wavetable layer.
Use short amplitude envelopes, selective rests and a filtered delay rather than a continuous pad.
Map two audible changes to macros and compare the printed phrase at matched level.

recipes.name: Air and motion
steps: Layer a harmonically simple bed with quiet wavetable or granular motion.
High-pass the wide texture so the sub stays clear.
Use slow modulation, then verify mono fold and low-band width after printing.

recipes.name: Acid with accents
steps: Use legato glide with a short gate and strong filter-envelope movement.
Vary resonance and cutoff across the phrase, preserving kick/sub space.
Print only the explicit patch and keep applied values with the MIDI.
